results.text: "Tightest" could mean the lowest available liquidity or the lowest net expected settlement, and entities rank differently on each. On available 24-hour liquidity, Synthetic Entity 01 in USD is tightest at **USD 5.38 million**. On net expected settlement, Synthetic Entity 04 in CAD is lowest at **USD 0**. Tell me which measure you want.

sql.command: SELECT entity_name, currency, available_liquidity_24h_usd, expected_inbound_settlements_usd - expected_outbound_settlements_usd AS net_expected_settlement_usd FROM aa_liquidity_position ORDER BY available_liquidity_24h_usd ASC
